comments: Free check of the homepage only; the form asks the user to confirm they own or manage the store. Not legal advice. Submitted by the vendor.
features: Free online check of a Shopify store's public homepage. It opens the page like any visitor and is read-only. It reports the accessibility issues software can find against WCAG 2.0 and 2.1, Levels A and AA. The report appears on the page in about a minute. Email is optional.
title: VibeFix Shopify Accessibility Checker
